/--
Let \( D \) be a unique factorization domain.
Prove that if every nonzero prime ideal of \( D \) is maximal, then \( D \) is a principal ideal domain.
-/
theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_of_isPrime_ne_bot_isMaximal {D : Type} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    [UniqueFactorizationMonoid D] (h : ∀ P : Ideal D, [P.IsPrime] → P ≠ ⊥ → P.IsMaximal) : IsPrincipalIdealRing D := by
  have hprime : ∀ P : Ideal D, P.IsPrime → Submodule.IsPrincipal P := by
    intro P hP
    haveI : P.IsPrime := hP
    by_cases hPbot : P = ⊥
    · refine ⟨⟨0, ?_⟩⟩
      rw [hPbot, Submodule.span_zero_singleton]
    · have hmax : P.IsMaximal := h P hPbot
      have hex : ∃ x ∈ P, x ≠ 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        push_neg at hne
        apply hPbot
        rw [eq_bot_iff]
        intro x hx
        have hxz := hne x hx
        simp [hxz]
      obtain ⟨x, hxP, hx0⟩ := hex
      obtain ⟨s, hs_prime, hs_assoc⟩ := UniqueFactorizationMonoid.exists_prime_factors x hx0
      have hprod_mem : s.prod ∈ P := by
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hs_assoc
        have hxeq : x = s.prod * (u : D) := hu.symm
        have hsprod : s.prod = x * ((u⁻¹ : Dˣ) : D) := by
          rw [hxeq]
          rw [mul_assoc]
          simp
        rw [hsprod]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_right _ P hxP
      -- find a prime in s that lies in P
      have hex_p : ∃ p ∈ s, p ∈ P := by
        clear hxP hx0 hs_assoc x
        induction s using Multiset.induction with
        | empty =>
          rw [Multiset.prod_zero] at hprod_mem
          exfalso
          exact hP.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_iff_one P |>.mpr hprod_mem)
        | cons a t ih =>
          rw [Multiset.prod_cons] at hprod_mem
          rcases hP.mem_or_mem hprod_mem with ha | ht
          · exact ⟨a, Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _, ha⟩
          · have hpt : ∀ q ∈ t, Prime q := fun q hq => hs_prime q (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hq)
            obtain ⟨p, hpt2, hpP⟩ := ih hpt ht
            exact ⟨p, Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hpt2, hpP⟩
      obtain ⟨p, hps, hpP⟩ := hex_p
      have hp_prime : Prime p := hs_prime p hps
      have hp_ne_zero : p ≠ 0 := hp_prime.ne_zero
      have hspan_prime : (Ideal.span {p}).IsPrime :=
        (Ideal.span_singleton_prime hp_ne_zero).mpr hp_prime
      have hspan_ne_bot : Ideal.span ({p} : Set D) ≠ ⊥ := by
        rw [Ne, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_bot]
        exact hp_ne_zero
      have hspan_max : (Ideal.span {p}).IsMaximal := h _ hspan_ne_bot
      have hle : Ideal.span {p} ≤ P := by
        rw [Ideal.span_le]
        intro y hy
        simp at hy
        rw [hy]
        exact hpP
      have heq : Ideal.span {p} = P := hspan_max.eq_of_le hP.ne_top hle
      exact ⟨⟨p, heq.symm⟩⟩
  exact IsPrincipalIdealRing.of_prime hprime

/-- Let $A$ be a Dedekind domain and $\mathfrak{a} \neq 0$ an ideal in $A$. Show that every ideal in
 $A/\mathfrak{a}$ is principal. -/
theorem isPrincipalIdealRing_quot_of_isDedekind {A : Type} [CommRing A]
    [IsDedekindDomain A] (a : Ideal A) (ha : a ≠ ⊥) :
    IsPrincipalIdealRing (A ⧸ a) := by
  -- It suffices to show every ideal in the quotient is principal
  refine ⟨fun I => ?_⟩
  -- Pull back I to an ideal b of A containing a
  set b : Ideal A := I.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk a) with hb_def
  have ha_le_b : a ≤ b := by
    intro x hx
    simp [b, Ideal.mem_comap, (Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem).mpr hx, I.zero_mem]
  -- Step 1: I is the image of b under the quotient map
  have hI_map : I = b.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk a) := by
    rw [Ideal.map_comap_of_surjective _ Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective]
  -- Step 2: there exists x ∈ A such that b = Ideal.span {x} ⊔ a
  have hx_exists : ∃ x : A, b = Ideal.span {x} ⊔ a := by
    sorry
  -- Step 3: extract such an x and use it as generator
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hx_exists
  refine ⟨⟨Ideal.Quotient.mk a x, ?_⟩⟩
  -- Step 4: show I = span {x mod a}
  have hI_eq : I = Submodule.span (A ⧸ a) {Ideal.Quotient.mk a x} := by
    rw [hI_map, hx, Ideal.map_sup, Ideal.map_quotient_self]
    simp [Ideal.map_span]
  exact hI_eq

/-- Let $M$ be an $R$-module. The following are equivalent:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item $M$ is finitely generated.
    \item For every family $(Q_{\alpha})_{\alpha \in A}$ of $R$-modules, the canonical map
    $M \otimes_{R} \left( \prod_{\alpha} Q_{\alpha} \right) \to \prod_{\alpha} (M \otimes_{R}
    Q_{\alpha})$ is surjective.
\end{enumerate} -/
theorem finite_iff_surjective_linearMap {R : Type} [CommRing R]
    (M : Type) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] :
    Module.Finite R M ↔ ∀ {α : Type} (Q : α → Type),
    ∀ [(a : α) → AddCommGroup (Q a)] [(a : α) → Module R (Q a)],
        Function.Surjective (LinearMap.pi (
            fun i => LinearMap.lTensor M (
                LinearMap.proj i (φ := Q) (R := R)))) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · -- Forward direction
    intro hFin α Q _ _
    -- Extract a spanning finset
    have hSpan : ∃ s : Finset M, Submodule.span R (s : Set M) = ⊤ := by
      have := (Module.finite_def.mp hFin)
      rcases (Submodule.fg_def.mp this) with ⟨T, hTfin, hTspan⟩
      refine ⟨hTfin.toFinset, ?_⟩
      simpa [Set.Finite.coe_toFinset] using hTspan
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hSpan
    -- Bridge lemma
    have bridge : ∀ {N : Type} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (z : TensorProduct R M N),
        ∃ g : M → N, z = ∑ m ∈ s, m ⊗ₜ[R] g m := by
      intro N _ _ z
      sorry
    intro y
    choose g hg using fun a => bridge (N := Q a) (y a)
    refine ⟨∑ m ∈ s, m ⊗ₜ[R] (fun a => g a m), ?_⟩
    funext a
    have hcomp : (LinearMap.lTensor M (LinearMap.proj a (φ := Q) (R := R)))
        (∑ m ∈ s, m ⊗ₜ[R] (fun b => g b m)) = ∑ m ∈ s, m ⊗ₜ[R] g a m := by
      rw [map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro m _
      simp [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul]
    simp only [LinearMap.pi_apply]
    rw [hcomp, ← hg a]
  · -- Backward direction
    intro hSurj
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hSurj (α := M) (Q := fun _ => R) (fun m => m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R))
    -- Local bridge lemma
    have bridge : ∀ (x : TensorProduct R M (M → R)),
        ∃ t : Finset M, ∀ (L : (M → R) →ₗ[R] R),
          (TensorProduct.rid R M) ((LinearMap.lTensor M L) x) ∈
            Submodule.span R (t : Set M) := by
      intro x
      induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero =>
        refine ⟨∅, ?_⟩
        intro L
        simp
      | tmul m f =>
        refine ⟨{m}, ?_⟩
        intro L
        simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.rid_tmul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp))
      | add x₁ x₂ ih₁ ih₂ =>
        obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := ih₁
        obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := ih₂
        refine ⟨t₁ ∪ t₂, ?_⟩
        intro L
        simp only [map_add]
        refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ ?_
        · refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ (ht₁ L)
          intro a ha
          simp [Finset.coe_union]
          exact Or.inl ha
        · refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ (ht₂ L)
          intro a ha
          simp [Finset.coe_union]
          exact Or.inr ha
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := bridge x
    have hMem : ∀ m₀ : M, m₀ ∈ Submodule.span R (t : Set M) := by
      intro m₀
      have hL := ht (LinearMap.proj m₀)
      have hxm : (LinearMap.lTensor M (LinearMap.proj m₀ (φ := fun _ : M => R) (R := R))) x
          = m₀ ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : R) := by
        have := congrArg (fun f => f m₀) hx
        simpa using this
      rw [hxm] at hL
      simpa using hL
    have hTop : Submodule.span R (t : Set M) = ⊤ :=
      eq_top_iff.mpr (fun m _ => hMem m)
    refine Module.Finite.mk ?_
    exact ⟨t, by simpa using hTop⟩
